name: the-model-lab
description: Turn any expertise into visual selling and teaching models. Four model engines (Core Model, Value Pyramid, Mountain, Three Roads), each with a guided interview, a live self-drawing worksheet (editable HTML with autosave), an editable PDF, and a 7-minute draw-along script. Built on Daniel Paul's Model Method: geometry carries the logic, labels stay under five words, every model has an entry, a pathway, a punchline and an exit.
